title: [Exercise] Get GRU4Rec Working on your Desktop

cues.en: GRU RNN's are complicated beasts, and building a GRU-based recurrent neural network is actually a very complicated task as well.
cues.zh: GRU RNN 很複雜，建立以 GRU 為基礎的循環神經網路，也很複雜。

cues.en: It would be crazy to try and write it from scratch if you don't have to.
cues.zh: 如果沒必要，還從零寫，太瘋狂。

cues.en: As with most scientific progress, you want to build upon the work of others whenever you can, just don't cross the line of stealing someone else's work and calling it your own.
cues.zh: 像大多數科學進步，能利用他人成果就利用，但別越線，偷別人工作，稱為自己的。

cues.en: So your challenge is to do exactly that: build upon the work of others, and get a GRU RNN running on our MovieLens data.
cues.zh: 挑戰就是，利用他人成果，讓 GRU RNN 在 MovieLens 資料上運作。

cues.en: The authors of the paper published code along with it, but it was written in Theano, which is kind of like Tensorflow, but Tensorflow is what ultimately took off, not Theano.
cues.zh: 論文作者附程式碼，但用 Theano 撰寫，類似 TensorFlow；最後真正普及的是 TensorFlow，不是 Theano。

cues.en: Even though the paper is only a couple of years old, a lot has changed in that time.
cues.zh: 即使論文才幾年，期間已改變很多。

cues.en: So if you were to adapt the ideas in this paper to Tensorflow, you might have to learn Theano first and port everything over to Tensorflow.
cues.zh: 因此，要將想法改成 TensorFlow，可能先學 Theano，再全部移植。

cues.en: But, it turns out someone else has done that already too, and that's what this bit.ly link will lead you to.
cues.zh: 但也已經有人做了，bit.ly 連結就帶到那裡。

cues.en: It's a GitHub project by a bright Chinese researcher named Dr. Weiping Song.
cues.zh: 是一位優秀中國研究者 Weiping Song 博士的 GitHub 專案。

cues.en: It's very close to what we need to run it within our Anaconda environment with a modern Python and Tensorflow installation, but even though this project is less than a year old, it's already out of date.
cues.zh: 很接近我們需要的，能在現代 Python、TensorFlow 的 Anaconda 環境執行，但即使專案不到一年，也已過時。

cues.en: So your challenge is to download a copy of this project from GitHub and get it running.
cues.zh: 挑戰是，從 GitHub 下載專案副本，讓它運作。

cues.en: To do so, you'll need to take care of a few things.
cues.zh: 需要處理幾件事。

cues.en: The first problem is that it's written for Python 2.7, but the world has since moved on to Python 3.
cues.zh: 第一，用 Python 2.7 寫，但世界已轉向 Python 3。

cues.en: There will be some minor syntactical things you'll need to address just to get the code to compile, such as replacing calls to xrange with range, and replacing sort with sort_values.
cues.zh: 有些小語法問題，要修正才能編譯，例如 xrange 換 range，sort 換 sort_values。

cues.en: This project also uses the Pandas and scikit-learn libraries, which you might not have installed yet if you skipped the Intro to Deep Learning section.
cues.zh: 也使用 pandas、scikit-learn，如果跳過深度學習入門，可能還沒安裝。

cues.en: So, you may need to import the Pandas and scikit-learn module into your RecSys environment using Anaconda Navigator in order for this code to run.
cues.zh: 因此，可能需要用 Anaconda Navigator，將兩個模組安裝到 RecSys 環境，才能執行。

cues.en: Next, you need to modify the code that reads in the MovieLens data, because it was written for a different data set with a different format.
cues.zh: 接著，修改 MovieLens 載入程式，因為原本為不同格式、不同資料集撰寫。

cues.en: You'll need to change the column names, paths, and separators.
cues.zh: 要改欄名、路徑、分隔符號。

cues.en: Pay particular attention to the column names because they crop up in several places within the code.
cues.zh: 特別注意欄名，在程式多處出現。

cues.en: The code assumes you already have the data split out into training and test sets as separate files, and we don't.
cues.zh: 程式假設資料已分成獨立訓練與測試檔，但我們沒有。

cues.en: So you'll also need to modify this code to create a train/test split on the MovieLens data when it runs.
cues.zh: 因此，也要修改程式，執行時將 MovieLens 做訓練／測試分割。

cues.en: As you're working, take care to create fresh new kernels each time you run the code.
cues.zh: 操作時，每次執行，都要建立全新核心。

cues.en: Close out the output console window in Spyder, and use a fresh one every time you run it.
cues.zh: 關閉 Spyder 輸出主控台，每次使用新的。

cues.en: Otherwise, you'll encounter some very confusing error messages that are just a result of having state left over from the previous run in memory.
cues.zh: 否則，會遇到非常混淆的錯誤，只是因為記憶體殘留前一次狀態。

cues.en: Have a go at it, and see if you can get it running.
cues.zh: 試試，看能否運作。

cues.en: In the next video, I'll give you a peek at my own results.
cues.zh: 下一支影片，給你看我的結果。
